messages:
maria: FYI invoice preview noise — a cohort of small tenants showing ~+30% token counts in preview after last night's metering deploy. No corresponding production trace increase. Anyone on ingest/tally?
kevin: Can you share tenant id and the preview diff?
sophie: We merged the compact-agg-window + ttl-snapshot change (PR #8212) around 23:00 UTC. That enlarged dedupe snapshot TTL from 1h -> 3h to fix long-running streams. Could be related.
maria: sample tenant: tenant_9f2b. Quick aggregation I ran: 
```
SELECT hour, SUM(tokens) FROM tally_agg WHERE tenant_id='tenant_9f2b' AND hour >= '2026-03-18' GROUP BY hour;
```
kevin: Query shape looks fine. Do you have raw event ingress counts vs aggregated tallies? A TTL expansion shouldn't increase tokens unless events are being accepted multiple times.
ingest-bot: alert: metering.ingest.fanout.latency spike at 2026-03-18T23:10Z (+2.3s) — consumer: tally-finalizer-2
alex: My suspicion: dedupe TTL overlapping with compact-agg windows caused the finalizer rerun to accept the same fingerprint across hour boundary, incrementing token tallies twice. We did flip TTL in migration to 3h.
sophie: Right 94 the migration aimed to reduce attribute misses, but we didn't update the compact-agg window logic to coalesce snapshot ranges.
maria: logs show repeat accepts for same fp near the border: 
```
2026-03-18T23:09:41Z INFO accept_fingerprint tenant=tenant_9f2b fp=abc123 session=...
2026-03-18T23:09:42Z INFO accept_fingerprint tenant=tenant_9f2b fp=abc123 session=...
```
kevin: Two remediation paths: 1) emergency revert TTL to 1h (fast), 2) patch dedupe key to include finalized_window_start (safer, avoids window overlap). Revert is faster for SLOs but needs a post-revert backfill to repair any overcount in previews.
alex: Revert + hotfix seems pragmatic. We'll need to coordinate a backfill and flag affected previews as "estimated" in console.
sophie: I'm opening an emergency PR to flip TTL back and to add a canary check that computes per-tenant preview delta pre/post. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/8340. It also emits `metering.rollback_hint=true` telemetry for affected commits.
maria: Console UX: previews are currently being shown without any context. Can we add a small banner: "Invoice preview may be affected by recent metering rollout; numbers are provisional." Also add a hide-previews toggle. PMs are already pinging finance.
kevin: Short-term banner + toggle. Long-term: console should list metering rollouts that touched tally/ttl and surface the rollout timeline next to invoice previews.
sophie: Deployed a patch to revert TTL in the staging cluster; will promote to prod after smoke tests. Also adding a reconciliation job that emits per-tenant deltas to observability.
ingest-bot: notice: reconciliation job queued for 100 tenants, ETA ~22m
maria: Action items: Sophie revert now, Kevin coordinate backfill with finance (expected window & tenants), Alex draft rollback runbook and postmortem skeleton, I'll add the console banner and toggle (PR coming). :thumbsup:
kevin: cc @finance for visibility, will follow up once reconciliation output lands. :eyes:
alex: prepping rollback runbook + smoke test checklist.
maria: Moving discussion to #release-war-room for the revert window; will post timestamps and canary metrics there.
